disclosures: Per NC General Statutes 42-52, the deposit must be returned within 30 days of lease termination.
An interim accounting is permitted if deductions cannot be finalized within 30 days due to pending repairs.
notes: North Carolina allows an interim accounting if repairs cannot be completed within 30 days.
The final accounting must be provided within 60 days of move-out.
Deposit cannot exceed two months' rent for month-to-month, or one and a half months for terms longer than month-to-month.
